enhance.globalMerge: Applies to all profiles, after app settings. The global script, profile config and profile script can still change the result.
enhance.globalScript: Applies to all profiles, using the result of the global config merge. The profile config and profile script can still change the result.
enhance.profileMerge: Applies only to this profile, after the global config and global script. The profile script can still change the result.
enhance.profileScript: Applies only to this profile, using the result of the profile config merge. This is the last extension step before app settings are reapplied.
enhance.order: Order: Original profile → App settings → <globalMerge>Global extend config</globalMerge> → <globalScript>Global extend script</globalScript> → <profileMerge>Profile extend config</profileMerge> → <profileScript>Profile extend script</profileScript> → App settings reapplied
enhance.settingsPriority: Note: Fields managed by app settings always use those settings in the final config. Changing these fields in extensions has no effect.
